ModMetaData.name: D'thorga Triage
ModMetaData.author: Phobos A. D'thorga
ModMetaData.description:
Doctors queue the life-saving operations a patient needs, and take the worst case first.
A patient with a condition that is killing them and that only an operation can fix (a collapsed lung, a bleed in the brain, a closing airway, whatever a mod brings) gets the operation queued by the doctors themselves: the one most likely to succeed among those your colony can do, with a doctor skilled enough and the ingredients in stock, never riskier than you allow. When no one can do it, a message says what is missing.
Each colonist, slave, prisoner and guest has a button saying how far the doctors may go without orders: never, to save life (the default for your own people and your prisoners), to save life or a limb, or for any repair. Guests start at never. The defaults by group are settings.
Doctors with several patients take the worst case first, by a triage tag read from how soon each condition kills and how far the patient's vital functions have fallen: immediate, urgent, delayed, minor, or expectant when nothing can be done. Hold Alt or select the patient to see the tag and why.
Any mod's surgery qualifies: operations are found by the condition they remove, never by name. Bills the mod queued are withdrawn once the condition is gone; bills you added are never touched.
Needs D'thorga Framework. No Harmony. Safe to add to a running colony.
